items.title: Diana Hu Is YC's Newest Managing Partner
items.summary:
We're thrilled to announce that Diana Hu has been promoted to Managing Partner at Y Combinator.

Few people have built a startup from zero and also shipped tech to 100 million people. Diana has done both.

items.title: Adding Canada Back to Our List of Accepted Countries of Incorporation

items.title: Congratulations to EquipmentShare on Going Public
items.summary: Today, EquipmentShare (YC W15) goes public. From Missouri to 373 locations nationwide, they've built the operating system construction has been missing—built by contractors, for contractors. Congrats to Jabbok, Willy, and the EquipmentShare team on a huge milestone.

items.title: Meesho Goes Public
items.summary:
Meesho goes public today. From S16 to IPO, they’ve built one of India’s largest e-commerce platforms—empowering millions of small merchants to grow their businesses.

Congrats to Vidit and Sanjeev on a decade of relentless building and listening to users!

items.title: Congratulations to Groww
items.summary: Today, Groww, India's leading digital investing platform, goes public. Tens of millions use Groww to invest simply and confidently in stocks, mutual funds, and ETFs. As YC's first company to list in India, we couldn't be more proud.

items.title: BillionToOne Goes Public — The Startup That Made Genetic Testing Universal
items.summary: Today, BillionToOne goes public, becoming YC's fourth publicly traded biotech company. More importantly, they have built one of the most important genetic tests in the U.S. Today, 1 in 11 babies born in the US are tested with BillionToOne's fetal genetic test.
